verification.subject: Your verification code - PawMeet
verification.heading: PawMeet Verification Code
verification.body: Use the code below to verify your email:
verification.ignore: If you didn't create an account, ignore this email.

passwordReset.subject: Password reset code - PawMeet
passwordReset.heading: PawMeet Password Reset
passwordReset.body: Use the code below to reset your password:
passwordReset.ignore: If you didn't request a reset, ignore this email.

gdprExportReady.subject: Your data export is ready - PawMeet
gdprExportReady.body: Your GDPR data export is ready for download.
gdprExportReady.expiry: Important: the link expires in 48 hours.
gdprExportReady.legal: The export contains all personal information associated with your account, as required by GDPR (Art. 15 and Art. 20).
gdprExportReady.notRequested: If you didn't request this export, contact us at

gdprExportFailed.subject: Data export error - PawMeet
gdprExportFailed.body: Unfortunately, an error occurred while generating your data export.
gdprExportFailed.retry: You can try again from the Settings section of the app. If the problem persists, contact us at

adminInvite.subject: You've been invited as an administrator - PawMeet
adminInvite.heading: Welcome to the PawMeet Admin Panel
adminInvite.body: You've been invited as an administrator on the PawMeet platform. Use the credentials below to log in to the admin panel.
adminInvite.changePasswordNote: You will be asked to change your password on first login.
adminInvite.ignore: If you weren't expecting this invite, ignore this email.

accountDeleted.subject: Your PawMeet account has been deactivated
accountDeleted.body: We confirm that your PawMeet account has been successfully deactivated.
accountDeleted.retention: Your personal data will be permanently deleted within 30 days, as required by GDPR (Art. 17).
accountDeleted.undo: If you change your mind, you can contact us within 30 days at
accountDeleted.farewell: Thank you for being part of the PawMeet community.
